body.title: fix(cmd): preallocate env var key slice
body.body:
**What this PR does / why we need it**:

`getSortedEnvVarKeys` builds a slice of the env var names by appending in a loop over a map whose size is already known. This preallocates the slice with the map length to avoid repeated reallocation. Behavior and output order are unchanged.

**Special notes for your reviewer**:

Draft; small cleanup, existing `helm env` tests cover the output.

**If applicable**:
- [ ] this PR contains user facing changes (the `docs needed` label should be applied if so)
- [ ] this PR contains unit tests
- [x] this PR has been tested for backwards compatibility
